scoring_justification: The checker recomputes the expected critical lengths from the paper's asymptotic formulas and compares the agent's CSV. This is a deterministic, self-contained recompute with no external ground-truth files needed.

hidden_assets.purpose: Expected critical lengths derived from paper's asymptotic formulas (Eqs. 28, 30) and the curve shape of Figure 10
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper (Garagash & Germanovich 2012; Azad et al. 2017), Figure 10 and equations (28), (30)
hidden_assets.generation_method: Blending of the asymptotic limits (u→0 and u→0.4) with polynomial terms to smoothly match the published figure; no random or fabricated data.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Gold directly derived from the paper's reported analytical relationships and the deterministic curve trend, not invented from outside the paper.

schema.description: Columns: understress_normalized (float, (τ_p-τ_0)/τ_p), critical_HF_length (float or empty/string 'stable'), critical_slip_length (float or empty/string 'stable').

outputs.description: Critical hydraulic fracture half-length and slipping patch half-length as a function of fault understress, verifying the stability boundary τ_0=τ_r.

output_contract.notes: The checker compares the reported critical lengths at several understress values to hidden reference data derived from the paper's Figure 10, and confirms that for understress ≥ 0.4 the agent reports stable slip (empty or 'stable'). Trends are also verified (divergence near τ_r, vanishing near τ_p).
